scenario.name: r-rc-2-delegate-request-compaction
scenario.description: Parent fires continue_delegate to a child that calls request_compaction. Accepts actual compaction path or structured below-threshold rejection as environmental honest limit.
scenario.notes: Does not lower thresholds or mutate config. Default public/disposable outcome is expected to be REQUEST_COMPACTION_REJECTED_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD.

expectedReceipts.name: parent-dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted parent sessions.send proof turn

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-requested
expectedReceipts.description: Parent agent was instructed to call continue_delegate(mode=normal)

expectedReceipts.name: child-report-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate child returned a request_compaction result sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: threshold-rejection-or-accepted-compaction
expectedReceipts.description: Either structured context-threshold rejection or accepted/post-compaction path observed

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for gateway/session dispatch correlation when available

review.notes: R-RC-2 is HONEST-LIMIT-candidate when the delegated child reaches request_compaction and receives a structured below-threshold rejection. A true accepted compaction path remains fixture-gated until reviewed tiny-context env/config exists.

liveRunSafety.notes: Runs in disposable session by default and delegates request_compaction to child. Does not mutate config; if compaction unexpectedly accepts, mutation is confined to proof child/session and result is review-gated.
